senses.gloss: (I)--a dynasty of १४ rulers, ruled for १०५ years [५०० years (वा। प्।)] after the Yavanas; reigned for ७००० years? Br. III. ७४. १७२-6; M. २७३. १९, २१; वा. ४५. ११८; ४७. ४४; ५८. ८३; ९८. १०८; ९९. ३६०. ३६२.

(II) (च्)--a northern kingdom;
1: Br. II. १६. ४७; १८. ४६; ३१. ८३.
१४ kings of it ruled for १०५ years after the Yavanas.
2: M. १२१. ४५; १४४. ५७.

--a class of Devas, sons of Kratu and तुषिता, twelve in number, being sons of दक्षिणा. Flourished in the [page२-032+ ३५] स्वायम्भुव epoch.
1: भा. IV. 1. 8.
They were also Jayadeva gods of the स्वारोचिष epoch.
2: Ib. VIII. 1. २०; Br. II. ३६. 7-१२; M. 9. 9. वा. ६६. 8; ६७. ३५; ९०. ३४.
They were the same as Jayadevas of the स्वायम्भुव.
3: Br. III. 3. 8 and १९; 4. २८; ६५. ३५.
Thirty-three in number, belong to the Sumanasa group of the 4th सावर्ण Manu;
4: Ib. IV. 1. ८७.
Gods also of the चाक्षुस epoch known as आदित्यस्.
5: M. 6. 3-१२.
These are the twelve आदित्यस् of the Vaivasvata epoch;
6: Vi. I. १५. १२७. १३१-32; Ib. III. 1. १०.
known as प्राणख्यस् in the यज्ञस्.
(I)--the wife of वेदशिरस् and mother of Vibhu. भा. VIII. 1. २१.

(II)--the wife of Kratu and mother of the तुषित gods in the स्वारोचिष epoch;
1: Br. II. ३६. 8; वा. ६२. 8; ६७. ३५.
gave birth to विष्णु by name Ajita in that epoch.
2: Br. III. 3. ११-15.
(III)--the mother of यजिष in the स्वारोचिष epoch. Vi. III. 1. ३७.
(I)--a daughter of दक्ष, and a wife of Dharma, gave birth to मुद। (सन्तोष-वा। प्। and वि। प्।). भा. IV. 1. ४९ and ५१; Br. I. 9. ४९, ५९; वा. १०. २५. ३४: ५५. ४३; Vi. I. 7. २३ and २८.
(II)--a son of Vasudeva and मदिरा. Br. III. ७१. १७२. [page२-033+ २९]
(III)--a शक्ति on the fourth Parvan of the Geya- cakra. Br. IV. १९. ७१; ४४. ७१.
(IV)--a कला of the moon. Br. IV. ३५. ९२; M. २३. २४.
--a son of Ugrasena. भा. IX. २४. २४; Br. III. ७१. १३३.
